notes.title: Planned game update
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone, dear cat hunters! 🐾[/p][p]We've stopped sitting idle and are now hard at work on a brand new free update for the game![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]What can you expect in the upcoming update?[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]🐱 The kitties will be even livelier!
🎨 A Brand New, Shiny UI! We're completely overhauling the user interface to make it more intuitive, user-friendly, and simply a pleasure to look at. Finding kitties should be a comfortable and enjoyable experience!
🤫 And that's not all... We've got a couple more surprises up our sleeves that we can't quite reveal yet. Let's just say: the most observant players will have something truly special to discover![/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank you for your continued support! We can't wait to show you everything new. Stay tuned for more updates![/p]

notes.title: Update 24.02.2025
notes.content:
Fixing achievements, now they are always given for all caught cats (except for multiplayer mode for speed).
NPCs no longer give the same group of hints, and cats are also counted correctly (but be careful, sometimes you can find a very similar cat).
Tomorrow you will have the opportunity to take several quests at once!

notes.title: Big update, NPCs!
notes.content:
As you asked. We've added NPCs! Now they'll give you hints about where the little rascals are hiding.
The lighting has also been reworked.
The cats now have their favorite hiding spots, find out all of them.
You can try the new timed competition mode with friends!

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
This update fixed the following:
• Korean, Japanese do not work in notifications
• Congratulations after catching all cats
• When you re-enter the settings, the sound setting is reset to 50%
• Camera picture breaks (better, but no full)
• Counting cats found in the gallery
and many other small bugs.
Enjoy your searches!
